reading.passage: Football began over two thousand years ago in ancient China as a game called cuju. The football we know today took shape in Britain, where it was given clear rules. It is cheap and simple to play, which is why it has become the world's favourite game.
reading.passageCn: 足球两千多年前起源于中国古代,当时叫蹴鞠。我们今天所知的足球在英国成形,并被定下了明确的规则。它便宜又简单易玩,所以成了全世界最受欢迎的运动。

questions.q: Where did modern football get its clear rules?
Why has football become the world's favourite game?
opts: It is cheap and simple to play.

writing.prompt: Write a short sports story about yourself. Say what sport you do, how you got started, and your goal for the future.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇关于你自己的简短运动故事:你做什么运动、当初如何开始、未来的目标(试着用上不定式,如 a sport to enjoy / strong enough to win)。

lines.text: Our school has new sports clubs. Which one will you join?
lines.cn: 我们学校有新的运动社团,你想加入哪个?

lines.text: Football, I think. It's cheap, and you only need a ball to play.
lines.cn: 我想加足球社。它便宜,只需一个球就能玩。

lines.text: I'd rather try tai chi. It's slow, but it builds balance.
lines.cn: 我更想试太极。它虽慢,却能练平衡。

lines.text: Good idea. The main thing is just to keep moving.
lines.cn: 好主意。最重要的就是动起来。

lines.text: Why do you go running every evening?
lines.cn: 你为什么每天晚上去跑步?

lines.text: To deal with the stress of a busy day. Afterwards my worries disappear.
lines.cn: 为了缓解忙碌一天的压力。跑完后烦恼就消失了。

lines.text: Isn't it hard when your legs ache?
lines.cn: 腿酸痛的时候不难受吗?

lines.text: A little, but I'm strong enough to keep going now.
lines.cn: 有点儿,但我现在已经足够强壮,能坚持下去了。
